requirements.title: Share Test Article with Designated Reviewers
requirements.definition: Provide the test article through a Google Doc shared with the two designated reviewers so they can access it while the primary client contact is unavailable.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested delivery and access behavior, separate from the article's editorial content and length constraints.

requirements.title: Revise Test Article from Editorial Feedback
requirements.definition: Revise the test article in response to Fire & Spark's editorial comments, including adding engaging storytelling or introductory text to break up long informational lists.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested editorial changes form one bounded revision task; its turnaround date is a task parameter. The independently adjustable word-count constraint remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Test Article Word-Count Constraint
requirements.definition: Treat approximately 1,000 words as a flexible article-length target rather than a hard maximum, allowing additional content needed for the requested improvements.
requirements.boundary_note: Article length can be changed or evaluated independently from the requested storytelling and feedback revisions, so it is retained as a separate content constraint.

requirements.title: Update Compression Springs Landing-Page Copy
requirements.definition: Update the copy on Century Spring's existing compression-springs landing page according to section-specific instructions to be supplied in the task brief.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct landing-page copy assignment, separate from the completed test article; rates, estimated hours, meeting arrangements, and projected monthly workload are administrative rather than Requirement atoms.

unresolved_candidates.description: Century Spring supplied additional feedback and edit suggestions for the test article, but the message does not clearly direct the freelancer to implement another revision cycle and the linked suggestions are unavailable.
